english.title: Interfere with a vehicle / buoy / anchor / chain / rope / mark used by the Commissioners
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without just and sufficient cause, interfered with

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[a buoy]_
(C)_[an anchor]_
(D)_[a chain]_
(E)_[a rope]_
(F)_[a mark]_

being used for the purpose of a function of the Commissioners under Parts III to VII of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979
english.legislation: Contrary to section 85(1) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
